snippet.title: Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan: Juuyuushi Inbou Hen — [ Playstation ] — Intro & Gameplay
snippet.description:
We journey now to a romanticized Meiji era, this is,

Rurouni Kenshin: Meiji Kenkaku Romantan: Juuyuushi Inbou Hen

Translated as "Ten Heroes Conspiracy" ( I was right before trying to google translate this! yay! ), this game takes place before the Kyoto Arc and you play as one of two amnesiac stricken characters originally named Hijiri and Hikaru ( according to wikia ), although you are free to name the character whatever you'd like. If the music and general gameplay seem stuttery, it's because it is. I had to use a different sound plugin so it wouldn't do that weird double-audio sound issue that I had in Air Combat, but this caused the game itself to at times, feel like I was running in mud, and music to be slow.

Gameplay wise, it plays like a mix of J-RPG and, what I'd say, "the origin of Fate Extra's system", which is a rock paper scissors system where Low beat Medium, Medium beat High, and High beat Low. Or something like that. Along with some special moves to utilize. A rather fun system I have to say.

In my opinion, this game is far better than most Rurouni Kenshin games with the exception of one particular one.
So this comes very much recommended.

Remember to Leave a Comment, and Like!
